# Castle Packaging

> Castle Packaging is a Bengaluru-based paper bag manufacturer and custom digital printing studio. We make paper bags, covers, cups and tissues, and digitally print full-colour on finished products — boxes, bagasse, cloth and jute — from a single piece, with rush orders for events. We also print finished jute, cloth and paper bags for bag makers.

## Company

- Name: Castle Packaging

## Products

- Paper Bags — kraft, recycled and virgin paper, custom sizes and printing, for retail, food and gifting.
- Paper Covers — V-bottom kraft paper covers without handles, sold by weight (per kg), for bakeries, pharmacies and grocery stores.
- Paper Cups — food-safe paper cups in multiple sizes, for cafes, events and food service.
- Paper Tissues — hard, semi soft, soft and virgin cellulose fibre grades, for HORECA, retail and institutional use.
- Digital Printing — full-colour printing on finished items in paper and board, bagasse, cloth and jute. No minimum order, rush orders welcome.
- Printing for Bag Makers — jute, cloth and paper bag makers send finished bags; we print their customers' designs.
